verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear size hierarchy and even vertical rhythm, but alignment is mixed: the headline and the teal line are left-aligned and pushed off-centre while the body copy and footer are centred, and the footer is small. B is cramped. Its body copy and footer are almost as large as the headline, so the fine print competes with the message. The teal line is shifted right, close to the edge, and the dashed dividers press against the text.
